_meta.description: SSoT for contextual page help. Claude updates this when screens change.
_meta.format: Each page has: title, description, tips (array), tasks (array)

/dashboard.title: Dashboard
/dashboard.description: Your home base showing key metrics, recent activity, and quick access to important items.
tips: Click any metric card to drill down into details
Recent items show your last 10 accessed records
Use the quick actions bar for common tasks
tasks: View overdue tasks and upcoming deadlines

/tasks.title: Task Hub
/tasks.description: Manage all your tasks, to-dos, and action items in one place.
tips: Use filters to show only your tasks or all team tasks
Click a task to view details and add comments
tasks: Create new tasks with the + button
Mark tasks complete with the checkbox

/email.title: Email
/email.description: Unified inbox showing emails from all connected accounts (IMAP and Microsoft 365).
tips: Emails are automatically linked to jobs and contacts
Use the search bar to find specific emails
Star important emails for quick access
tasks: Link emails to jobs or contacts

/jobs.title: Jobs
/jobs.description: Central hub for all construction jobs and projects.
tips: Use filters to find jobs by status, type, or date
Click a job code to open job details
The status column shows current workflow stage

/jobs/[id].title: Job Details
/jobs/[id].description: Complete view of a single job including all tabs, documents, and related data.
tips: Use tabs to navigate between Overview, Documents, Emails, Schedule, etc.
The breadcrumb shows your location - click to go back

/contacts.title: Contacts
/contacts.description: Directory of all people and companies you work with.
tips: Search by name, email, or company
Click to view full contact details
Use filters to show only suppliers, clients, etc.

/estimates.title: Estimates
/estimates.description: Create and manage job estimates and quotes.
tips: Use templates for faster estimate creation
Items pull from your pricebook automatically

/purchase_orders.title: Purchase Orders
/purchase_orders.description: Manage supplier purchase orders and track deliveries.
tips: POs link to jobs and suppliers automatically
Track delivery status with the status column
Export POs to PDF for sending

/warehouse.title: File Warehouse
/warehouse.description: Central document storage for all files across jobs, contacts, and emails.
tips: Browse by folder structure (Jobs, Contacts, Emails, etc.)

/corporate.title: Corporate
/corporate.description: Manage company groups, subsidiaries, and corporate compliance.
tips: View company hierarchy in the tree view

/settings.title: Settings
/settings.description: Configure your account and organization settings.
tips: Personal settings affect only your account

/settings/system.title: System Settings
tips: Scheduled Jobs show background task status

/settings/system/navigation.title: Navigation Manager
/settings/system/navigation.description: Control sidebar navigation items, ordering, and visibility.
tips: Use the visibility toggle to show/hide items

/settings/users.title: User Management
/settings/users.description: Manage team members, roles, and permissions.
tips: Deactivate users to revoke access without deleting

/settings/roles.title: Access Control
/settings/roles.description: Configure roles, permissions, and access groups.
tips: Roles define what users can see and do
Test permissions with the preview feature

/settings/company.title: Company Settings
tips: Brand colors affect buttons and accents throughout the app

/settings/connections.title: Connections
/settings/connections.description: Manage integrations with external services (Storage, Email, Xero).
tips: Storage provider syncs documents to cloud

/settings/connections/provider.title: Storage Provider
/settings/connections/provider.description: Configure cloud storage for documents (SharePoint, S3/Wasabi, Local).
tips: Only one storage provider can be active at a time

/settings/integrations/xero.title: Xero Integration
/settings/integrations/xero.description: Connect to Xero for accounting sync (contacts, invoices, bills).
tips: Check sync status in the dashboard

/settings/integrations/microsoft.title: Microsoft 365 Integration
/settings/integrations/microsoft.description: Connect Microsoft 365 for email and OneDrive/SharePoint sync.
tips: Admin consent is required for organization-wide access
SharePoint folders appear in File Warehouse

/training.title: Training
/training.description: Access training materials and learning resources.

/notebooks.title: Notes
/notebooks.description: Create and organize personal and shared notes.
tips: Notes can be linked to jobs or contacts

/data-warehouse.title: Data Warehouse
/data-warehouse.description: Advanced data management and reporting tools.
tips: Run custom queries on your data

/system-health.title: System Health
/system-health.description: Monitor system status, background jobs, and performance.
